ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 3:1 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white zones centrally located on both lobes. Low-intensity black border tracking the trailing edge and outer margins. Multiple vertical/diagonal low-intensity streaks extending from the lower visible region upward. One isolated circular low-intensity pixel cluster located in the central field of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped vertex with an approximate internal angle of 45 degrees; the apex is sharp and extends below the current water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of peaks (serrations) with amplitudes of 3-8 pixels compared to the smoother proximal section of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave parabolic curves fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, sweeping toward sharp distal tips; the left tip exhibits a more pronounced posterior curl.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white circular clusters (~3-5 pixels diameter) detected against the dark background of the distal left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear pixel disruptions (5-50 pixels in length) oriented vertically and diagonally, predominantly on the lower half of both lobes, breaking the high-intensity white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged margin and high-contrast surface irregularities present on the outer distal portion of the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, isolated high-contrast dark circular focal spot located in the mid-section of the left lobe's high-intensity white field.
